$comment: Minimal agent/tool/prompt registry seed (decision D7 — Level-100 governance). Every production agent and tool must have an entry with an owner, risk tier, and eval status before it ships. Served read-only by the MCP server's list_agents / list_tools tools.

tools.name: validate_artifact
tools.purpose: Schema + consistency validation of an agent artifact

tools.name: get_schema
tools.purpose: Serve an agent's input/output JSON Schema

tools.name: get_shared_context
tools.purpose: Serve org-structure / operating-model ground truth for grounding

tools.name: extract_handoffs
tools.purpose: Extract scoped handoff packets from a validated brief

tools.name: render_diagram
tools.purpose: Regenerate the operating-model diagram from palette + template
tools.notes: Only overwrites generated diagram artifacts; deterministic from source of truth.

prompts.name: base_agent
prompts.purpose: Shared base system prompt composed into every agent
